en: Black‑and‑white waterfront scene of a fishing harbor with small wooden boats moored along a wooden quay. Several men walk along the pier among nets and fishing gear. Traditional wooden houses and boathouses with tiled roofs line the water. The image has printed caption text at the bottom left and a small triangular logo with a number at the bottom right, typical of vintage postcards.
